info.title: WebEngine CLI - persistent local browser and mobile automation
info.description: WebEngine CLI and local daemon for persistent Selenium browser automation sessions.

options.name: --json
options.description: Emit a machine-readable response on stdout.

options.name: --pipe
options.description: Override the default per-user named pipe.

options.name: --quiet
options.description: Suppress daemon lifecycle diagnostics.

options.name: --session
options.description: Target an existing web session.

options.name: --headless
options.description: Start the browser without a visible window.

options.name: --url
options.description: URL to navigate to.

options.name: --ref
options.description: Reference returned by the latest inspection.

options.name: --text
options.description: Text to type or visible option text to select.

options.name: --text-file
options.description: Read UTF-8 text from a file instead of the command line.

options.name: --stdin
options.description: Read all text from standard input.

options.name: --key
options.description:
Named key to send: Enter, Tab, Escape, Backspace,
Delete, Space, Home, End, PageUp, PageDown, or ArrowUp/
ArrowDown/ArrowLeft/ArrowRight.
